verdict.rationale: Measuring detection quality against labelled cases is a fair question for an AML monitoring platform, but the evidence documents no precision/recall, false-negative or validation-set measurement. Rule Simulation (testing rules before deployment) and alert statuses such as CLEARED are related features. Neither measures detection quality or incorrect clearances against labelled ground truth.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
